acceptanceCriteria: A read-only projection lists hunks ranked by (AI-authored, unwitnessed, uncovered) with each factor cited or marked unknown.
A fixture proves a commit without a git-ai note is reported as authorship unknown.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. `internal/gitnotes` already reads the git-ai `refs/notes/ai` line-authorship log (V1-0093). Joining it with `corvint witness` and CEM coverage yields a review order: AI-authored lines with no exercising test first. Authorship stays repository-history, never authority (invariant 3), and a missing note yields unknown authorship, not human authorship. Related: the hunk-anchored CEM review projection idea. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: review: order review by AI-authored, unwitnessed hunks using git-ai notes, witness and the CEM
